hints.title: Cumulative Partition Aggregation
hints.text: Compute a running sum of session metrics partitioned by user identity across chronological timestamps.

hints.title: Window Function Ordering
hints.text: Apply an aggregate summation window partition by player ordered by date to accumulate values monotonically.

hints.title: Running Total Blueprint
hints.text: Select player_id, event_date, and sum(games_played) over (partition by player_id order by event_date) as games_played_so_far.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT
    player_id,
    event_date,
    SUM(games_played) OVER (
        PARTITION BY player_id
        ORDER BY event_date
    ) AS games_played_so_far
FROM Activity;
```

variables: N: number of records in Activity table
complexity.notes: Window sort and prefix sum calculation evaluate in linear-logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Self-join quadratic accumulation scales poorly on large log volumes.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Window frames compute running sums in a single pass without Cartesian products.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of standard SQL window functions with PARTITION BY and ORDER BY clauses.

    SUM(games_played) OVER (
        PARTITION BY player_id
        ORDER BY event_date
    ) AS games_played_so_far
FROM Activity;

import pandas as pd

def gameplay_analysis(activity: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    activity = activity.sort_values(by=['player_id', 'event_date'])
    activity['games_played_so_far'] = activity.groupby('player_id')['games_played'].cumsum()
    return activity[['player_id', 'event_date', 'games_played_so_far']]
